selector_metric: original joint standardized MAE, raw state
training: original V12 random K16 joint periodicTabM; only per-row/head Poisson1 weights change; constant AdamW, no SWA, EMA, Huber or covariance

selection.confirmation: retain chosen development target; four seed gains each positive, one-sided seed tLCB95(df3)>0 AND mean mechanism positive
selection.exploration: at most one positive-mean target, distinct from formal promotion; never automatic release

seed_history: previously used splits over same official rows; not new independent datasets
queue: approved fallback after JOINT_COV_MSE_V1 complete publication 83f44d4

ema.refit: fresh initialization, EMA reset, same selected epoch
ema.independent_arithmetic: saved initial + every raw update; independent float64 recurrence

control_identity: local/runs/tabm-head-bootstrap-v1 all phases; zero new control fits
formal_gate_scope: four reused official split seeds are split stability, not new independent datasets; time only; all positive, seed tLCB95>0, paired mechanism vs Bootstrap>0
